answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 2355 Country: Pakistan Title: What says the islamic jurisprudence and islamic jurists about the use of suppositories in the Holy month of Ramadhan in lavatories if prescribed by the doctors. Question: What says the islamic jurisprudence and islamic jurists about the use of suppositories in the Holy month of Ramadhan in lavatories if prescribed by the doctors. Allah bless you with countless rewards in both worlds Answer ID: 2355 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1045/1045=J) The Sawm (fasting) becomes invalid by inserting suppositories in anus or vagina. Therefore, one should adopt any other means of medication or he or she should do it in nights: أو أدخل أصبعہ الیابسۃ فی دبرہ أو فرجھا ولو مبتلۃ فسد، وقال فی موضع آخر أو احتقن أو استعط الخ قضی (الشامی: ط زکریا: 3/369 و 376) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
